verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a REST Developer API for pulling notes, action items, and recordings with diarized, timestamped transcripts, using cursor pagination across all list endpoints. Note content comes back as Fellow Markdown, which is GitHub-Flavored Markdown with extensions, and the Super Admin API explicitly lets admins retrieve, export, and delete workspace-wide data to back up notes and transcripts. That export, however, is API-driven, workspace-wide only on the Enterprise plan, and has no documented self-serve bulk export. missing for 10: a self-serve full-account export (UI or bulk download) for non-Enterprise users, documented export of recorded audio/video media, an exit/deletion workflow for individual users, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of complete data export.
